# Agentic AI in the Wild: Rethinking Trust When Your AI Has the Keys

#### View a Complimentary Live Webinar Presented by Confidential Computing Consortium

The era of agentic AI isn't coming; it's already running across the enterprise and touching sensitive infrastructure with a level of autonomy that most security architectures were never designed to handle. This webinar explores how to use Confidential Computing to protect your enterprise in the new and rapidly evolving world of agentic AI. Learn more about the expanding threat surfaces that emerge when AI agents operate autonomously across enterprise environments, from prompt injection and model tampering to data exfiltration through compromised runtimes, and why vulnerabilities uncovered through new agentic tools make clear that traditional perimeter-based defenses are no longer sufficient.

Hear directly from experts at Edgeless Systems, Intel and NVIDIA on the front lines of agentic AI deployment as we examine where existing security stacks fall short and how Confidential Computing delivers the hardware-rooted, full-stack trust model that agentic AI demands, securing models, data, and execution environments from silicon to cloud. Hosted by the Confidential Computing Consortium ahead of [Confidential Computing Summit 2026](https://events.linuxfoundation.org/confidential-computing-summit/), this talk will provide the essentials for enterprise security architects, AI infrastructure leads, and anyone responsible for deploying AI in regulated or high-stakes environments who refuses to let speed of adoption outpace security posture.

### Speakers

#### Daniel Rohrer, VP of Software Product Security, Architecture, & Research, NVIDIA

Daniel Rohrer is VP of Software Product Security, Architecture, and Research at NVIDIA. In his 27 years at NVIDIA, he has led efforts to enhance AI security, verifiable workloads, deliver GPU confidential computing, and advance research efforts in secure platform design. Daniel has taken his integrated knowledge of "everything NVIDIA" to hone security practices, explore novel cybersecurity solutions, and help deliver some of the world’s most advanced and trustworthy computing platforms. He currently serves on the Board of Directors of OASIS Open (2024-2026), where he contributes expertise in AI security and open standards development in addition to serving on NVIDIA's AI Ethics Review Committee.

#### Jesse Schrater, Principal Engineer, Data Center & AI Security, Intel

Jesse Schrater is Principal Engineer of Data Center & AI Security at Intel, with over 30 years of experience in Information Technology, Jesse has an extensive background in driving technology solutions for large organizations. He has led engineering, service, and marketing teams in enterprise cloud and cybersecurity domains. Jesse currently leads go-to-market activities for Intel data center security technologies and services, including PQC, Confidential Computing, and ConfidentialAI. Prior to joining Intel, Jesse was a consulting Systems Analyst for the State of California and served in Intelligence Systems for the US Air Force. Jesse has an MS in Information Technology and a BS in Computer Science, both from the University of Maryland.

#### Felix Schuster, CEO, Edgeless Systems

Felix Schuster is a computer security researcher turned startup founder. After his PhD and a stint at Microsoft Research working on the foundations of confidential computing, he co-founded Edgeless Systems. Today, Edgeless builds privacy infrastructure for the AI era: Contrast shields entire Kubernetes deployments with hardware-enforced confidential computing, and Privatemode AI brings that same guarantee to GenAI inference.

#### Rachel Wan, CCC Outreach Vice Chair, Confidential Computing Consortium

Rachel Wan served as the Outreach Chair in 2025 and currently serves as the Outreach Vice Chair in 2026, supporting member engagement and facilitating a wide range of consortium outreach. She works with the Outreach Committee to lead and coordinate several member-driven initiatives and events, as well as ongoing marketing efforts. Rachel is dedicated to serving the community by further broadening outreach efforts, empowering members, and continuing the consortium's success.

# 實際環境中的代理型 AI：當你的 AI 掌握關鍵權限，信任必須重新思考

#### 免費觀看由機密運算聯盟（Confidential Computing Consortium）主辦的線上研討會直播

代理型 AI 的時代並非即將到來，而是已經在企業各處運作，並以多數資安架構從未預期要因應的自主程度，接觸敏感基礎設施。本場線上研討會將探討如何運用機密運算（Confidential Computing），在快速演進的代理型 AI 新時代中保護企業。你將進一步了解，當 AI 代理程式在企業環境中自主運作時，攻擊面如何隨之擴大——從提示詞注入、模型竄改，到透過遭入侵的執行環境外洩資料；同時也將說明，為何新型代理工具揭露的漏洞已清楚顯示，傳統以邊界為基礎的防禦方式不再足夠。

來自 Edgeless Systems、Intel 與 NVIDIA 的專家，將分享他們部署代理型 AI 的第一線經驗。我們將檢視現有資安架構的不足之處，以及機密運算如何提供代理型 AI 所需、以硬體為信任根基的全端信任模型，從晶片到雲端，全面保護模型、資料與執行環境。本場演講由機密運算聯盟主辦，並於 [2026 年機密運算高峰會（Confidential Computing Summit 2026）](https://events.linuxfoundation.org/confidential-computing-summit/)前舉行，將為企業資安架構師、AI 基礎設施負責人，以及所有負責在受監管或高風險環境中部署 AI、不願讓導入速度超越資安防護能力的人員，提供不可或缺的核心知識。

### 講者

#### Daniel Rohrer，NVIDIA 軟體產品安全、架構與研究副總裁

Daniel Rohrer 是 NVIDIA 軟體產品安全、架構暨研究副總裁。在 NVIDIA 任職的 27 年間，他帶領團隊強化 AI 安全與可驗證工作負載、推出 GPU 機密運算技術，並推動安全平台設計研究。Daniel 運用對「NVIDIA 一切事務」的整合性知識，精進安全實務、探索創新的網路安全解決方案，並協助打造多款全球最先進且值得信賴的運算平台。他目前擔任 OASIS Open 董事（2024–2026 年），除參與 NVIDIA 的 AI 倫理審查委員會外，也為 AI 安全與開放標準制定貢獻專業知識。

#### Jesse Schrater，Intel 資料中心暨 AI 安全首席工程師

Jesse Schrater 是 Intel 資料中心暨 AI 安全首席工程師，擁有超過 30 年的資訊科技經驗，並具備為大型組織推動技術解決方案的深厚背景。他曾領導企業雲端與網路安全領域的工程、服務及行銷團隊。Jesse 目前負責 Intel 資料中心安全技術與服務的市場推廣工作，包括後量子密碼學（PQC）、機密運算（Confidential Computing）與機密 AI（Confidential AI）。加入 Intel 前，Jesse 曾任美國加州政府的系統分析顧問，也曾於美國空軍的情報系統部門服役。他擁有馬里蘭大學資訊科技碩士與電腦科學學士學位。

#### Felix Schuster，Edgeless Systems 執行長

Felix Schuster 原為電腦安全研究員，後來投入創業。他取得博士學位後，曾在微軟研究院從事機密運算基礎技術研究，之後共同創立 Edgeless Systems。如今，Edgeless 致力於打造 AI 時代的隱私基礎設施：Contrast 透過硬體強制執行的機密運算，保護整個 Kubernetes 部署環境；Privatemode AI 則將同等保障延伸至生成式 AI（GenAI）推論。

#### Rachel Wan，機密運算聯盟（CCC）推廣委員會副主席

Rachel Wan 曾於 2025 年擔任推廣主席，目前則擔任 2026 年推廣副主席，協助促進成員參與，並推動聯盟多元的對外交流工作。她與推廣委員會合作，領導並協調多項由成員推動的倡議與活動，以及持續進行的行銷工作。Rachel 致力於服務社群，進一步拓展對外交流、賦能成員，並延續聯盟的成功。
